title: profile.json principal
description: The own columns of the principal of the person (one object). Times are RFC 3339 in UTC.

id.description: ID of the principal, the ID of the person.

kind.description: Kind of the principal; always user for a person.

handle.description: Handle of the person, unique without regard to case.

avatar_file_id.description: ID of the avatar file; absent without an avatar.

disabled_at.description: When the account was disabled; absent when it is not disabled.

deleted_at.description: When the account was deleted; absent when it is not deleted.
